description: Capabilities granted to the panel, the small always-on-top window in the corner of the screen that shows a meeting about to start, voice typing listening, or a conversation from the talk key. It listens for the shell's events and calls only the three shell commands its page names (ui/src/panel/panel.ts): the cards it should show, a button pressed on one, and how tall the cards are. Not `call`: nothing the panel does goes through a service command. No dialogs, no opener, no notifications.
